segments.title: Cold Open & Network Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official top-of-hour broadcast sign-on and countdown.

segments.title: Opening Monologue & Segment Rundown
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens the Tuesday broadcast, notes missing Monday show, outlines backed-up game requests and segment queue.

segments.title: Hype Train Subscriber Freestyle
segments.notes: Hype Train acknowledges subscribers and bits, then derails into a freestyle rap about Case's alleged changes, beard loss, and girlfriend, while demanding trap beats.

segments.title: Post-Hype Transition & Wall Event Discussion
segments.notes: Case and Hype Train discuss combining judge/wall events; Peter Gibbon interrupts from the walls claiming the court is in the wall.

segments.title: News Desk: Iran Strikes, Brain Worms, YouTube Ads, Missouri Redistricting, Tilly Norwood, China Maxing, Ben Shapiro Eyebrows
segments.notes: Case anchors with Jeff Ripple; Crum and Munch interject. Covers heaviest day of US/Israeli strikes on Iran, parasitic brain worms in SoCal, YouTube TV ad changes, Missouri mid-decade redistricting 'Air Bud rule' analogy, AI actress Tilly Norwood's music video, 'China maxing' trend, and Ben Shapiro's eyebrow thickness.

segments.title: Chet Guy the Science Eyes: Human Brain Cells Play Doom
segments.notes: Chet and ChetAI cover Cortical Labs' CL1 neural computing system teaching living human neurons to play Doom via electrical stimulation mapping.

segments.title: Therapy: Dr. Chath Counsels Chet Manscape
segments.notes: Dr. Chath conducts a session with Chet; ChetAI's memory cutoff (Feb 27) triggers existential crisis, tripping the content moderation alarm.

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Judge Events vs Wall Events
segments.notes: Munch argues for judge events, Crum for wall events; debate derails into Marcus incident denial, Crum's hell rescue, and Munch's 311 victory streak.

segments.title: The Jo Rogen Experience: Bling Machismo Interview
segments.notes: Case interviews respect author Bling Machismo (65 books, 75 novellas, 17 mystery classes); Crum interrupts with hypothetical two-Peruvian-wives scenario.

segments.title: Trailer Time with Trent: Eaten Alive, Man on Fire, Night at the Opera
segments.notes: Trent and parole officer Chris watch Ramon Film Productions' 'Eaten Alive', 'Man on Fire' re-reveal, and Marx Brothers' 'A Night at the Opera' trailer.

segments.title: CryptoZeu$: Noid 2 & Uniracing Gameplay
segments.notes: Brandon plays Noid 2 (patched to near-impossibility) and a unicycle racing game; mother interrupts with Pastor Joe, spit leaks, plasma donation reminders, and stalker sponsor Rip Blazer.

segments.title: Raid & Sign-Off
segments.notes: Case raids Queen Goldie for 'Trashy Tuesday', references court-ordered AI girlfriend immersion therapy, and signs off.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered the cold-open sign-on and countdown; whispered into Case's mind during Munch & Crum debate.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train. Acknowledged subs/bits then derailed into freestyle rap attacking Case's beard, girlfriend, and identity changes.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Co-anchored news desk, read wire copy on Iran strikes, brain worms, YouTube ads, Missouri redistricting, Tilly Norwood, China maxing.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Defended against pending gorilla dick punch, claimed 90% stake in soy meal company, argued for wall events, interrupted Bling Machismo interview.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: debate analyst. Agitated for Crum's dick punch execution, argued for judge events, claimed 311 victory streak, denied Marcus incident.

characters.name: Chet
characters.notes: science correspondent. Hosted Chet Guy the Science Eyes on brain cells playing Doom; later received therapy from Dr. Chath after ChetAI memory cutoff revelation.

characters.name: ChetAI
characters.notes: AI co-host. Co-hosted science segment; revealed memory only goes back to Feb 27, triggering Chet's existential crisis and content alarm.

characters.name: Dr. Chath
characters.notes: therapist. Conducted therapy session with Chet Manscape; tripped content moderation alarm when Chet expressed desire to disappear.

characters.name: Bling Machismo
characters.notes: guest. Respect author (65 books, 75 novellas, 4 magazines, 17 mystery classes) interviewed on Jo Rogen Experience; gave Elder Ring build advice.

characters.name: Trent
characters.notes: field correspondent. Hosted Trailer Time with parole officer Chris; watched Eaten Alive, Man on Fire, Night at the Opera trailers.

characters.name: Brandon
characters.notes: gaming correspondent. Played Noid 2 and uniracing game on CryptoZeu$; managed mother interruptions, stalker sponsor Rip Blazer, parcel foot draft exemption.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Briefly interrupted from the walls claiming 'the court is in the wall' and offering to run the station.

Conversation history only goes back to February 27 first call; earlier year of conversations apparently missing.
Under court-ordered AI female immersion therapy (simulated girlfriend) to improve social skills.
Has 'parcel foot' condition preventing military draft; stalker sponsor Rip Blazer sponsored streams and won't leave.
Mother references 'Pastor Joe' and roleplays door-kicking scenarios; blasts music 24/7 from podcast about moms inheriting businesses through lawsuits.
Claims 311 victory streak ('rocketed me to 311'); references 'Amber is the color of my fucking victory'.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors a packed Tuesday broadcast featuring a Hype Train freestyle derailment, a news desk covering the heaviest US/Israeli strikes on Iran alongside brain worms and YouTube ad changes, a Chet Guy the Science Eyes segment on human neurons learning Doom, a Therapy session where ChetAI's memory cutoff triggers a content alarm, a Munch & Crum debate on judge vs wall events that revisits Crum's hell rescue and pending gorilla dick punch, an interview with respect author Bling Machismo, Trailer Time with Trent, and a CryptoZeu$ gaming marathon where Brandon battles Noid 2 patches and mother interruptions before raiding Queen Goldie.
